newsitem.title: USA: PacifiCare to sell Fla. operations.
newsitem.headline: PacifiCare to sell Fla. operations.

text.p: PacifiCare Health Systems Inc said on Friday that it has signed an agreement to sell its Florida subsidiary, PacifiCare of Florida, to Total Health Choice, the newly-formed Florida subsidiary of Total Health Care Inc, a 55,000-member, Michigan-based HMO.
Terms of the transaction wre not disclosed.
The transaction is set to close upon completion of state regulatory approval.

PacifiCare of Florida, established in 1994 through the acquisition of two Miami-based health plans, has about 30,000 members in small group, individual and Medicaid health plans, which operate in Dade, Broward, Palm Beach, Glades, Hendry, Lee, Hillsborough and Pinellas counties.
PacifiCare Health Systems has operations in California, Florida, Oklahoma, Oregon, Texas and Washington.
